IGN® and IGN Entertainment are trademarks or registered trademarks of IGN Entertainment, Inc. Back To Top Dead by Daylight • Oct 28, 2026 Dead by Daylight - Official Terrifier Teaser Trailer
 Check out the Terrifier Teaser Trailer for Dead by Daylight, an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game developed by Behaviour Interactive. Players can get a brief look at the terror that awaits with a new vicious Killer entering the game as Terrifier. Terrifier comes to Dead by Daylight on November 17 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
